jobs.title: Embedded Systems Architect
jobs.shortDescription: Own embedded systems architecture at VD Intellisys Technologies Pvt Ltd across UAV/drone platforms, SMT (pick-and-place) machines, and robotics. Requires 10+ years of embedded systems experience, including at least 3 years as an architect or technical lead.
jobs.description:
You will own the embedded architecture across our hardware programmes: UAV/drone platforms, SMT (pick-and-place) machines, and an upcoming robotics programme. You will set the technical direction, lead a cross-functional team of embedded and software engineers, and take products from R&D prototype to production.

Why Join Us
You will build indigenous drone, automation and robotics platforms from the ground up. You get real architectural ownership, a hands-on R&D culture and direct work with leadership.
responsibilities: Define the system architecture for each programme: compute, sensors, actuators, power and communication.
Set common hardware and firmware platforms so that the programmes can reuse modules.
Lead firmware design on MCUs and SoCs (STM32, ARM Cortex-M/A, NVIDIA Jetson or similar), using RTOS and embedded Linux.
Supervise flight control, motor control, motion control and sensor-fusion work, including PX4/ArduPilot, BLDC/servo drives and IMU/GNSS/vision.
Integrate imaging and edge-AI payloads with the control systems.
Own design reviews, HW–SW interface specs, test strategy and HIL/SIL setups.
Drive DFM, reliability, EMI/EMC and certification readiness (DGCA drone rules where applicable).
Mentor engineers, plan roadmaps and coordinate with vendors and component suppliers.
requirements: 10+ years in embedded systems, with at least 3 years in an architect or technical-lead role.
Strong C/C++. Deep knowledge of RTOS (FreeRTOS/Zephyr/NuttX) and embedded Linux (Yocto/Buildroot).
Hands-on experience with control systems: PID, motor control, kinematics or flight dynamics.
Peripheral and bus knowledge: CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, USB and MAVLink/ROS 2.
Can read schematics and work closely with PCB designers.
A track record of taking at least one embedded product from concept to production.
preferred: UAV, robotics or industrial automation background.
Experience with ROS 2, computer vision, thermal/EO imaging or edge AI (TensorRT, OpenCV).
Knowledge of functional safety or security (secure boot, OTA).
